title: Skill Browser GHA Auto-Build Setup
desc: How to configure GitHub Actions to auto-rebuild skill pages when skills are pushed. Covers skills/ fallback path, build trigger, auto-commit pattern.
steps: TRIGGER CONFIG: build-skill-page.yml triggers on push to skills/** and scripts/build-skill-page.py changes, plus workflow_dispatch and schedule cron 7 */6 * * * (every 6 hours).

SKILLS/ FALLBACK: build-skill-page.py HQ_SKILL_DIRS includes REPO_ROOT / 'skills' as final entry. GHA Ubuntu cannot access local D:/GitHub/WKAppBot/bin/wkappbot.hq/skills -- the committed skills/ directory is the only source in GHA. Local builds still read from HQ first (all 430+ skills). GHA builds read only committed skills (~50 SDK skills).
BUILD JOB: ubuntu-latest + Python 3.12 + python scripts/build-skill-page.py. On success: git add docs/skills/, commit 'chore: auto-rebuild skill pages [skip ci]', push.
VERIFY JOB (needs build-and-deploy): checkout ref main (gets latest auto-commit), checks docs/index.html + docs/skills/index.html + docs/skills/sitemap.xml exist.
PERMISSIONS: contents: write required (auto-commit needs push access).

GAP: GHA build produces fewer pages than local build (committed skills only vs full HQ catalog). Full rebuild requires local ./wkbuild-skills.sh + commit + push. GHA handles incremental updates when new skills are pushed.

DEPLOYMENT GAP: docs/skills/skills-data-full.js is generated by local build but NOT auto-committed by GHA (it reads from HQ which GHA cannot access). Must be manually deployed to wkappbot-harness private repo for Pro unlock to work.
author: claude
